record.question: Oldest oil field in India is:
record.explanation: Answer C: Digboi. Digboi in Assam is India’s oldest producing oil field/refinery area. Reference: https://www.dghindia.gov.in/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC Law & Judicial Paper-I, February 2026 examination; current officeholder/current affairs claims interpreted as of paper date..
